title: Para Bellum content: variants
description:
A DELTA on a model, never a copy: an up-armoured mark, a diesel conversion, a longer gun. File: Content/<namespace>/variant.json. A variant is its own DESIGN: it is produced and stockpiled separately from its model, and its id may not equal any model's id. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md section 3 in the game repository.

ONE LEVEL ONLY. A variant's model is always a model, never another variant. Depth is unnecessary because TRAITS COMPOSE: a mark plus a field modification is a variant carrying a trait, not a variant of a variant.

name.description: Display name. Optional: a missing or blank name displays the id.

model.description: The model this variant modifies, by MODEL id. Naming a variant here is refused.

traits_add.description: Traits the variant adds to its model's traits. Each must be legal on the model's class.

traits_remove.description: Traits the variant removes. Each must be one the model carries.

stats.description: Stat DELTAS added to the model's values. The container is required and may be {}; members are sparse, and an absent stat means no change. A delta may be negative, but the resulting value may not be. Keys must be on the model's class.

cost.description: Cost DELTAS per pool. The container is required and may be {}; members are sparse, and an absent pool means no change. A delta may be negative, but the resulting cost may not be.

production.description: Production DELTAS. The container is required and may be {}; its members are SPARSE, and an absent member means no change. Zero is a real delta, never a 'no change' marker. The result may not be negative. Recorded limitation: setting production to exactly zero must be written as a delta of minus the model's base.
